message.content: In the conversation, Jake Watson did indeed share common knowledge about the offside rule before transitioning into providing practical techniques for Li Hua. Specifically, Jake explained the offside rule to Li Hua, stating that a player is offside if they are closer to the opponent's goal line than both the ball and the second-to-last opponent when the ball is passed to them. He elaborated that this rule is designed to prevent unfair advantages and maintain the flow of the game. After explaining the concept, Jake proceeded to provide practical advice on how to avoid being offside, including tips on positioning and understanding the rule in various game scenarios. This shows that Jake first conveyed the foundational knowledge about the offside rule before moving onto more specific guidance.
